history.recommendation_text: The Board recommended that the Administration: (a) plan for the automated preparation of the financial statements under Umoja; and (b) without waiting for the implementation of Umoja, enhance internal documentation on the preparation of the financial statements and, more generally, on all financial procedures, notably by updating the Financial Manual.
history.administration_response: Implemented. The financial statements module of Umoja is being used to prepare the 2016 financial statements for the Secretariat. It streamlines the financial statement preparation process and reinforces standardization, consistency, transparency, accountability and controls. Staff have been trained to use this new software and regular reviews are being conducted throughout the financial statement preparations for quality control. Subsequent to the audit, an updated version of the Finance and Budget Manual was released. Based on the above, the Administration requests that the recommendation be closed.
history.board_assessment: The Board noted that the 2016 volume I financial statements were issued through Umoja. The Board considers this recommendation as implemented.
